context.requirement: Build a Python URL shortener with an API to create short links, redirect to the original URL, and report per-link click analytics. Use persistent storage, validate inputs, and handle short-code collisions safely.

work_items.deliverable: Define create, redirect, and analytics API behavior
Persist short links and click counters reliably
Implement validated APIs and collision-safe codes
Cover API behavior, analytics, and failure cases
Document APIs, assumptions, setup, and limits

decisions: Keep generated changes in a run-scoped artifact directory; never edit the target workspace automatically.
Run test and documentation work as independent branches, then synchronize before release review.
Use explicit human approval before implementation and release readiness.
Expose POST /api/urls to create a short link, GET /{code} to redirect, and GET /api/urls/{code}/stats for click totals.
Use SQLite for durable local persistence, atomic click updates, and uniqueness-enforced short codes.
Validate destination URLs as HTTP(S); defer authentication, expiration, and distributed deployment because the brief does not define them.
risks: The public stats endpoint exposes click totals and destination URLs; add access control if those are sensitive.
SQLite is appropriate for a single-instance prototype, not a horizontally scaled production deployment.
Authentication, expiration, analytics retention, and availability targets remain undefined.
